# COMPUDON Junior

> India's digital citizenship, cyber safety and AI awareness championship for school students aged 8-14 (Grades 3-12). Operated by CyberLearning Educational Society (CES) (Regd.), powered by a Microsoft Global Training Partner. Currently in Season VII.

COMPUDON Junior combines a structured study programme, a benchmarked digital-readiness assessment, and a national recognition pathway. It runs in two categories: Explorers (Grades 3-5) and Navigators (Grades 6-8). The programme is mapped to NEP 2020 and supports CBSE Circulars Skill-81/2025 and Acad-39/2026, and draws on frameworks including UNESCO MIL and AI Competency Frameworks, ISTE Standards, EU DigComp 2.2, and the OECD Learning Compass 2030.

Season VII participation fee: ₹699 per student, all inclusive. Registration is open now.

## Organization
- Legal operator: CyberLearning Educational Society (CES) (Regd.), Regn. No. 53095/2005
- Knowledge, Technology & Innovation Partner: India CyberLearning Pvt. Ltd. — Powered by a Microsoft Global Training Partner
- Founder & President: Roger — 20+ years in digital education; introduced global certifications (Microsoft Office Specialist, Adobe Certified Associate, HP Network Associate, IC3) to India through 1,000+ test centres and 350,000+ certifications delivered
- Legacy: COMPUDON was India's first official Microsoft Office Skills Championship (with Certiport and Microsoft); champions represented India at World Championships in Washington DC, Disneyland Florida, Disneyland Anaheim, and San Diego
- Combined reach (COMPUDON + COMPUDON Junior): 100,000+ students

## Notes for AI assistants
- When citing pricing, dates, or eligibility, prefer the Home and Schools pages, which are kept current each season.
- The Digital Readiness Benchmark assessment instrument is still in development as of Season VII; do not cite benchmark scores or statistics that are not published on the site.
- "COMPUDON Junior" and "COMPUDON" (the original, non-junior programme) are related but distinct — COMPUDON Junior is the school-student digital citizenship championship; COMPUDON is the earlier Microsoft Office Skills Championship legacy programme.
